steps.source: function attempt(f:any){try{f();return "ok";}catch(e){return e.name;}}class C{}class D{}type T=[...[].<C>,...[].<string>,...[].<D>];const a:any=new C();const b:any=new D();const raw:any=[a,b];const t:T=raw;let calls=0;class E{operator string(){calls++;Object.setPrototypeOf(a,D.prototype);return "s";}}const e:any=new E();const failed=attempt(()=>{raw[1]=e;});failed+"/"+calls+"/"+String(raw is T)+"/"+String(a is D)+"/"+String(raw[1]===b);
